dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop 'O' shapes and semi-circular 'C' shapes with high-contrast dark-to-light gradients from the exterior perimeter to the interior core. Prominent rings located along the upper dorsal region exhibit jagged, non-uniform edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of isolated, solid low-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the mid-lateral and cervical regions, interspersed between larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triangular formation exists between the centroids of three large macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface, complemented by a secondary linear arrangement of smaller blobs following the curvature of the back.
